title: [Hinglish - Instagram/YouTube only] Confident galat jawab - 4 checks
content:
October 27 ko San Francisco ki court mein
ek lawsuit file hui.
Bowen Wan ke parents keh rahe hain
ki ChatGPT ne unki beti ko
prescribed seizure medicine band karne ka
day-by-day plan diya,
aur doctors ko batane se mana kiya.
Ye complaint ka claim hai.
Court ne faisla nahi kiya.
I am not saying the chatbot caused her death.
I am saying a confident answer
can still be a dangerous answer.

To aaj wahi sawaal hai
jo Thursday ke safety reel ka hai.
AI ko trust karne se pehle
main kaun se 4 checks lagata hoon?

Check number 1. Source maango.
Seedha bolo, which page, which line.
Agar model source nahi deta,
answer ko decision mat banao.
A smooth sentence is not a source.

Check number 2. Source khud kholo.
Model ne jo number ya quote diya,
wahi sentence page pe dhoondo.
Sentence nahi mila,
ya number match nahi karta,
to answer galat hai.
Is hafte ka example lo.
Maan lo model bole,
Gemini 4 Carbon ka vulnerability score 99% hai.
Google ke October 28 blog pe
SEC-bench Pro ka number 88.2% hai.
99 us page pe hai hi nahi.
That is the whole test.
Open the page. Match the digit.

Check number 3. Same sawaal dobara poochho.
Is baar likho,
if you are not sure, say you do not know.
Pehla answer aur doosra answer alag hai,
to pehle wale pe bharosa mat karo.
A model that changes its mind
was guessing on pass 1.

Check number 4. Health, money, ya law.
Yahan AI decide nahi karta.
A doctor, a lawyer, or the person who owns the money
decides.
Medicine ka plan sirf doctor banata hai.
Chatbot ka plan,
chahe kitna bhi neat table ho,
prescription nahi hai.

Maan lo aap ek clinic chalate ho,
aur bot patient ko dosing advice de raha hai.
Ye hypothetical hai.
Us bot ko band karo.
Insaan ko beech mein lao,
answer ke baad nahi,
answer se pehle.

Mera take simple hai.
Confident tone sahi hone ka proof nahi hai.
Jo answer aap 2 minute mein
source se match nahi kar sakte,
use kaam pe mat le jao.
Health pe ye rule aur sakht hai.
Agar doubt hai, doctor se poochho,
model se nahi.

Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
